build_sam2_predictor_from_pretrained: build a SAM2ImagePredictor from a pretrained Hugging Face model using from_pretrained
create_image_embedding: create image embeddings by calling set_image with a numpy array or PIL Image
predict_masks_from_prompts: predict segmentation masks from point prompts, box prompts, or mask input using predict
predict_batch_masks: predict segmentation masks for a batch of images using set_image_batch and predict_batch
get_image_embedding: get the image embedding tensor for the currently set image using get_image_embedding
